facts.fact: Central Bank of Seychelles Governor Caroline Abel says Airtel Seychelles' mobile money transfer service, launched in 2015, was licensed by the Central Bank.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Seychelles governor says the National Payment System E-Money Regulations were enacted in 2022 and facilitated Nebula Fintech's entry as a payment service provider.
The governor says Nebula Fintech Limited, a new non-bank payment service provider, entered the market under the 2022 E-Money Regulations.

SYC.note: No survey figure for account holding is given.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Seychelles governor says Airtel Seychelles launched a licensed mobile money transfer service in 2015, introducing e-money in the country.
